jamie: kicking off smoke tests now, will watch traces and errors :eyes:
priya: observability hooks added: perf dashboards + canary span sampling set. will alert on p95>100ms or error_rate>0.1%
DeployBot: Canary progress update (3m): 30/200 reqs, avg_latency=65ms p95=82ms errors=0.1%
tom: seeing a tiny p95 uptick on one shard in the dash, nothing alarming yet
jamie: running end-to-end convo replay against canary traffic, also sending test corpus through reranker
DeployBot: Canary finish: 200/200 reqs executed. metrics_summary: avg_latency=68ms p95=87ms (baseline p95=80ms, +8.8%) error_rate=0.22% (threshold=0.1%) throughput stable.
priya: error rate above threshold, QoS gate flagged :warning: — stacktrace sampling shows increased NPEs in tokenizer path for ~0.02% of requests
jamie: hmm, tokenizer NPEs weren't in canary smoke. @ana any recent infra changes that touch tokenization?
nana: (typo) ana: nope, no infra change. Last model pull was fine. Could be model artifact or breaking input case.
tom: given error_rate>threshold and p95 drift, I vote hold promotion and investigate. prefer to pin prod to last-known-good until root cause found.
jamie: agreed. Action: HOLD promotion. Pin prod tag to v2.7.0 and mark v2.7.1-canary as quarantined. I'll update release notes.
DeployBot: Action required: canary marked UNHEALTHY. Auto-rollback disabled for this pipeline. Manual rollback/promotion required.
priya: I'll run reproducer on canary nodes and collect full heap/coredump if it surfaces. Assigning to @priya.
jamie: ops runbook link: https://internal.redwood/release/runbooks/canary-handling — following steps 2-5 now.
nana: (typo) ana: also adding temporary traffic-split hold: keep at 5% until investigation completes. Do not promote.
tom: publish a short note in #incidents if this looks like customer-impacting — we currently see 0.02% user-facing errors so low but rising.
jamie: will draft brief: "Canary for v2.7.1 shows elevated error rate in tokenizer path; promotion on hold; pinning to v2.7.0." sending to #incidents in 10m if status unchanged.
DeployBot: Deployment event recorded: deploy_id=deploy-2063331234 canary_status=unhealthy action=hold pinned_prod_tag=v2.7.0
jamie: next steps: triage, collect sample inputs that cause NPE, attempt quick patch build (v2.7.1-hotfix1) behind feature flag, re-run canary. If not resolved within change window, plan rollback of canary artifacts and annotate release notes.
priya: collecting samples now. will post logs + repro gist in thread when ready.
nana: scheduling 15m sync in 8 minutes in #eng-releases to decide final action.
jamie: thanks everyone. tagging @tom and @priya for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
